real_vllm_cross_check.construction: mirrors vLLM's own tests/v1/core/utils.py create_scheduler: real ModelConfig(Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct) + SchedulerConfig(watermark=...) + CacheConfig(enable_prefix_caching=...) + KVCacheConfig(FullAttentionSpec) + register_all_kvcache_specs + real Scheduler + real block pool; ⑤ beat driven through the REAL update_from_output with hand-built ModelRunnerOutput; VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0 (MRV1 path); block_hasher = get_request_block_hasher(16, sha256)
real_vllm_cross_check.scenarios: 61 checks / 7 scenario groups — S1: FCFS tail preemption six-things (r2: PREEMPTED / computed=0 / num_preemptions=1 / spec_token_ids cleared / back at waiting HEAD via prepend / preempted_req_ids=={r2}) + guard (preempted step admits nobody); S2: self-preemption gives up the whole step (num_scheduled empty, total 0, preempted_req_ids=={r1}, no outputs); S3: WAITING admission failure never preempts in-flight (victim 0 preemptions, stays WAITING while r1 self-preempts); S4: tail-gives-up preemption -> cannot-fit stays PREEMPTED without harming big -> big self-preempts -> abort-of-PREEMPTED request removed from waiting -> victim resumes via resumed path (resumed_req_ids=={victim}, full 17-token recompute with APC off, status RUNNING); S5 (APC on): free keeps hashes -> preempted r2 resumes scheduling ONLY 1 token (32 hit + 1 recompute, resumed_req_ids=={r2}, computed catches up to 33) — the F2/m7 core claim live-verified; S6: watermark (int(0.5*11)=5 arithmetic on TOTAL blocks; first admission exempt while running empty; RUNNING growth exempt — 9th block granted under wm=5; WAITING admission rejected 1+5>free; wm=0 admits); S7: EOS->FINISHED_STOPPED->free->next-step finished_req_ids worker notice; stop_token->stop_reason==7; max_tokens->LENGTH_CAPPED; min_tokens gate suppresses EOS at outputs 1/2 then fires at 3; repetition [1,2,1,2,1,2]->FINISHED_REPETITION with stop_reason string; abort running (status/queues/ledger/idempotent second call returns []); abort-during-execution (update_from_output silent, freed request skipped by hot loop)

cross_check_debugging_findings: Driver iteration 1 had 3 failures, all diagnosed as DRIVER scenario-design errors, not implementation divergences: (a) growth loop bound too small (30 < 32 steps needed to exhaust); (b) resume scenario where the resumer's full sequence (65 tokens = 5 blocks) exceeded the pool's 4 usable blocks — real vLLM correctly rejects under full-ISL; the trimmed KVCacheManager's -1 hit-placeholder stub does not charge free blocks for shared hits, so the trimmed equivalent scenario admits — a documented stub boundary (impl-notes: '契约面而非分页器', block accounting归 ch13/14), not a scheduler-control-flow divergence; (c) identical prompts triggered cross-request APC sharing, preventing exhaustion; (d) after fixing, a partial-hit variant appeared (16-of-32) because the preemptor's next allocation LRU-recycled the victim's first cached block from the free-queue head — this is REAL vLLM behavior and live-demonstrates the dossier WC3 cost② '块被挤出哈希表 -> 部分重算' narrative; final scenario keeps the preemptor from allocating post-preemption (max_tokens=16) so the clean full re-hit is observed

S7g in-flight counter: after abort-during-execution the freed request is skipped by the hot loop (`request is None` continue), so its num_in_flight_tokens is intentionally left at 1 in BOTH real 0.26.0 and the trimmed version (same guard structure) — the trimmed unit test correctly does not assert this counter

coverage_map.conditional_trigger_discipline: preemption tests pin the trigger precondition structurally (pool sized exactly to exhaustion: 2 blocks with both held / 1 usable block / 4 blocks with a 64-token prompt) and then assert the target effects non-vacuously (preempted_req_ids non-empty, victim status/counters/queue position, guard skipping admission); the WAITING-never-preempts test asserts the negative (victim.num_preemptions == 0) after driving the in-flight request to actual self-preemption; watermark tests contrast the same pool with the knob on vs off; container cross-check re-proves all trigger conditions on the real block pool (usable = N-1 after null block)
